blurb: Guests can rent boats, kayaks, and stand-up paddleboards to explore the lake at their own pace. Winter storage options protect boats from harsh weather and include optional services like engine winterization and spring commissioning. Rentals include mandatory insurance with a deductible and safety gear for paddling.
extraNote: Mandatory insurance with $500 deductible held as a credit card hold at booking and released after return inspection · Multi-day boat renters responsible for fuel used during their trip · No alcohol consumption permitted while using kayaks or paddleboards · All equipment must be returned on time; additional charges apply for late returns
